title: area 2d collision detection not working on godot 4.5.1 stable
body: ### Tested versions tested vers: 4.5.1 stable 4.4.1 stable im up to further testing if necessary ### System information windows 11 - godot 4.5.1 stable - Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 7520U with Radeon Graphics (8 CPUs), ~2.8GHz ### Issue description collision detection on godot 4.5.1 doesnt work at all on my laptop to check if this is an actual issue i used the following code block in area2d `extends Area2D # Called when the node enters the scene tree for the first time. func _ready() -> void: print("area ready") # Called every frame. 'delta' is the elapsed time since the previous frame. func _process(delta: float) -> void: pass func _on_body_entered(body): print("entered:", body.name)` now this should print area ready and spam entered: character2d as seen in the image (sprite for visualisation) this doesnt happen on 4.5.1 the following is the same code block and the same test in 4.4.1 but just incase it makes a difference heres the 4.4.1 code block (also in area 2d) `extends Area2D func _ready(): print("Area ready") func _physics_process(delta): for body in get_overlapping_bodies(): print("Body detected:", body.name) ` results in the following image forgot to mention there was this following error which i think could be helpful in fixing this issue ERROR: Another resource is loaded from path '::w2peb' (possible cyclic resource inclusion). ### Steps to reproduce im guessing this is an issue with my laptop and or the integrated graphics i got but if i can help ill happily do so ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) as i said before im pretty sure this issue is specific to me but ill send both the 4.5.1 and 4.4.1 projects if it helps ive no idea if the issue is project dependent so to be safer than sorry im sending the files 4.4.1 project: [4.4.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24423607/4.4.zip) 4.5.1 project: [test-2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24423615/test-2.zip)
